description: This file defines the 'FieldDescription' class and its interface, which model metadata about a field within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes logic for handling field types and their syntax representations, primarily used in serialization or code analysis tasks.

classes.name: FieldDescription
classes.description: Represents metadata about a specific field in Orleans code generation, including its type, identifier, and syntax representation.

classes.name: IFieldDescription
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for field description metadata within Orleans code generation.

methods.name: GetTypeSyntax
methods.description: Returns a TypeSyntax representation of the provided ITypeSymbol.
